ceda.application: Python 3.12, Django 5.2 LTS (+ FastAPI for high-throughput services)
ceda.derived_from: SYN-MFS-002 v2.4 (Master Functional Specification, consolidated single volume, 13 Oct 2026)

ACA.SUBJECT_PLAN_PUBLISHED.trigger: Class subject plan published (course spaces created)

AGT.LEVEL_LOWERED.trigger: Error threshold breached (autonomy lowered one level)

ATT.REGISTER_MISSING.trigger: Register not taken by deadline (Register Agent)

BIL.INVOICE_OVERDUE.trigger: Invoice overdue (Fee Agent; never restricts education)

CERT.REISSUED.trigger: Reissue issued; original superseded at the same moment

CUR.ADOPTION_RESOLVED.trigger: Applicable version stamped for an institution and level

CUR.ASSIGNMENT_CHANGED.trigger: Teacher of record or co-teacher changed (G2/G3)

CUR.PUBLISHED.trigger: Version published (adoption resolved, schemes redrafted, G10)

DOC.INGESTED.trigger: Document stored (search indexed unless special category)

FAM.CONSENT_CHANGED.trigger: Consent given, refused or withdrawn (propagates immediately)

FCL.CHECK_PERFORMED.trigger: Clearance check run; each creditor and the family are notified

FCL.DECISION_RECORDED.trigger: Admission decision recorded on a clearance check

FCL.DISPUTE_RAISED.trigger: Obligation disputed (shown as disputed until resolved)

FCL.DISPUTE_RESOLVED.trigger: LGA or state resolved a dispute

FCL.EXCHANGE_QUERY_RECEIVED.trigger: Another state queried this registry; creditor institutions of a matched learner are notified

FCL.OBLIGATION_PUBLISHED.trigger: Creditor published or reconfirmed an obligation

FCL.OBLIGATION_SETTLED.trigger: Obligation settled, waived, written off, withdrawn or expired

GOV.CONFIG_PUBLISHED.trigger: A configuration layer section is published

GOV.POLICY_PUBLISHED.trigger: A rule version is published after its tests pass

GOV.SCOPE_CHANGED.trigger: Hierarchy node created, moved or closed (closure table rebuilt)

HR.BANK_ACCOUNT_CHANGED.trigger: Salary account changed after call-back and second approval (staff member notified)

HR.INTEGRITY_FLAG_RAISED.trigger: Payroll integrity scan raised a flag

HR.LEAVE_APPROVED.trigger: Leave approved — staff absence created and cover started (G8)

HR.PAYROLL_HOLD_DECIDED.trigger: A person decided to hold or release pay on a flag

HR.POSITION_CHANGED.trigger: Establishment position approved, frozen or abolished

HR.POSTING_APPROVED.trigger: Posting order approved (sending institution prepares handover — G9)

HR.POSTING_EFFECTIVE.trigger: Posting took effect: old post ended, new post filled, grants moved

HR.SEPARATION_RECORDED.trigger: Staff member separated from a post (access ends, classes reassigned)

IAM.USER_DEACTIVATED.trigger: Account deactivated (e.g. HR leaving date) — workspace channels removed

INS.APPLICATION_SUBMITTED.trigger: Institution registration or approval application submitted

INS.LICENCE_EXPIRED.trigger: Licence passed expiry (issuance and new entries blocked)

INS.STATUS_CHANGED.trigger: Institution lifecycle or onboarding status changed

INSP.FINDING_RECORDED.trigger: Finding saved in the inspection workspace

LMS.ASSIGNMENT_PUBLISHED.trigger: Assignment published to learners and parents

LRN.LEFT.trigger: Leaver recorded (unknown destination at compulsory age → CME referral)

PAY.RUN_APPROVED.trigger: Pay run approved by two people

PLT.TENANT_PROVISIONED.trigger: A tenant (state, private provider, network) is provisioned

PVT.SANCTION_APPLIED.trigger: Sanction step takes effect (admissions/exam entries blocked)

REG.PROFILE_CHANGED.trigger: An institution's regulatory profile gained, changed or ended a link

SAF.CONCERN_RAISED.trigger: Concern recorded — notification carries no detail

SAF.STAFF_CASE_OPENED.trigger: Staff case opened — designated officer notified without detail

SEN.ADJUSTMENT_CHANGED.trigger: Authorised adjustment changed (rooms, exams, assignments re-checked)

STF.AUTHORISATION_CHANGED.trigger: Authorisation added, verified or expired (G3 re-check)

STI.COURSE_PUBLISHED.trigger: A course version of a security training institution was published

STI.TRAINEE_OUTCOME_RECORDED.trigger: A trainee passed out, was commissioned, failed, relegated or withdrew

SUB.STATEMENT_SIGNED.trigger: Statement signed by state or operator

metrics.formula: count of active primary enrolments
metrics.name: Learners enrolled

metrics.formula: enrolled at level ÷ population of official age for level (population projections)
metrics.label: estimated
metrics.name: Gross enrolment ratio

metrics.formula: enrolled of official age at level ÷ population of official age
metrics.label: estimated
metrics.name: Net enrolment ratio

metrics.formula: population of compulsory age − enrolled of compulsory age
metrics.label: estimated
metrics.name: Out-of-school estimate

metrics.formula: learners enrolled at next stage in session t+1 ÷ learners completing stage in session t
metrics.name: Transition rate (primary → JSS → SSS → tertiary)

metrics.formula: institutions with onboarding_status = live ÷ institutions on the register
metrics.name: Institutions live

metrics.formula: present sessions (incl. late) ÷ possible sessions
metrics.name: Learner attendance rate

metrics.formula: learners with term attendance < 90% ÷ learners
metrics.name: Persistent absence rate

metrics.formula: learners with term attendance < 50% ÷ learners
metrics.name: Severe absence rate

metrics.formula: enrolments ended with leaving_reason dropped_out or unknown destination at compulsory age ÷ enrolled
metrics.name: Dropout rate

metrics.formula: registers submitted by deadline ÷ registers due
metrics.name: Register compliance

metrics.formula: staff present ÷ staff expected
metrics.name: Teachers present today

metrics.formula: mandatory class-subjects with a qualified teacher of record ÷ mandatory class-subjects
metrics.name: Curriculum coverage (qualified teacher of record)

metrics.formula: Σ min(1, delivered hours ÷ pro-rata required hours to date) averaged over class-subjects
metrics.name: Teaching-hours coverage

metrics.formula: 0.20·subject coverage + 0.25·teaching hours + 0.25·objectives delivered + 0.15·assessment coverage + 0.15·qualified staff (authority-configurable, versioned); bands ≥95 compliant, 80–94.9 partial, <80 non-compliant, insufficient data = not assessed
metrics.name: Curriculum compliance score

metrics.formula: count of open gaps; age = today − opened date
metrics.name: Open coverage gaps by severity and age

metrics.formula: teachers with valid qualification and TRCN registration ÷ teachers
metrics.name: Qualified teacher rate

metrics.formula: enrolled learners ÷ teaching FTE (by subject using class-subject assignments)
metrics.name: Teacher–learner ratio

metrics.formula: demand = Σ curriculum hours × classes ÷ max load; supply = authorised teaching capacity; gap = demand − supply
metrics.name: Teacher demand vs supply

metrics.formula: adults with valid mandatory training ÷ adults required
metrics.name: CPD and statutory training compliance

metrics.formula: mean score % of locked CA assessments
metrics.name: Continuous assessment average

metrics.formula: candidates with ≥ 5 credits including English and Mathematics ÷ candidates sitting
metrics.name: Exam pass rate (5 credits incl. English and Mathematics)

metrics.formula: learners at or above target grade ÷ learners with targets
metrics.name: Progress against target

metrics.formula: submissions on time or late ÷ expected submissions
metrics.name: Assignment completion rate

metrics.formula: active course spaces; assignments set per teacher per month; teachers setting ≥ 1 online assignment per month ÷ teachers
metrics.name: Digital adoption

metrics.formula: distribution of learners and teachers by level (1–5) per strand
metrics.name: Digital skills attainment

metrics.formula: count of concerns by category; groups < 10 suppressed above institution
metrics.name: Safeguarding concerns (counts only)

metrics.formula: positive events ÷ negative events
metrics.name: Positive-to-negative behaviour ratio

metrics.formula: learners on the SEND register with allocated provision ÷ learners on the register
metrics.name: SEND provision coverage

metrics.formula: count by severity
metrics.name: Facility safety incidents

metrics.formula: enrolled ÷ classrooms in use
metrics.name: Learners per classroom

metrics.formula: textbooks issued for subject and level ÷ learners at level
metrics.name: Textbook-to-learner ratio

metrics.formula: share of institutions with each facility; toilets per learner by sex
metrics.name: Water

metrics.formula: capitation received ÷ due
metrics.name: Capitation received vs due

metrics.formula: collected ÷ invoiced
metrics.name: Fee collection rate (private)

metrics.formula: actual ÷ budget by cost centre
metrics.name: Budget execution

metrics.formula: meals served ÷ learners present
metrics.name: School feeding reconciliation

metrics.formula: collection rate = collected ÷ (billed − exempted); outstanding = billed − exempted − collected; remittance variance = collected − remitted (aged)
metrics.name: SDAF billed

metrics.formula: 0.30·Completeness + 0.20·Uniqueness + 0.20·Validity + 0.15·Timeliness + 0.10·Consistency + 0.05·Verification (0–100)
metrics.name: Data Quality Index

metrics.formula: open probable duplicates ÷ learners
metrics.name: Duplicate learner rate

metrics.formula: verifications by result; open integrity alerts
metrics.name: Certificate verifications and integrity alerts

metrics.formula: pages captured, indexed and searchable; key-field accuracy; hours scan-to-searchable
metrics.name: Digitisation progress and quality

metrics.formula: institutions with stale datasets ÷ institutions live
metrics.name: Data freshness

metrics.formula: guardians with an active parent account ÷ guardians
metrics.name: Parent app adoption

metrics.formula: delivered ÷ sent; read ÷ delivered; median first response minutes; Σ cost
metrics.name: Messages delivered

metrics.formula: attended bookings ÷ learners invited
metrics.name: Parents' meeting attendance

metrics.formula: Σ wᵢ·sᵢ ÷ Σ wᵢ over available indicators (0–100, normalised to policy targets); missing indicators excluded and weights renormalised (tile shows 'partial'); bands ≥80 strong, 65–79 adequate, 50–64 concern, <50 critical
metrics.grain: day × institution (rolled up by enrolment-weighted mean)
metrics.name: Institution health index

metrics.formula: per institution in scope: level, ownership, enrolment, attendance, health index, curriculum coverage, exam results, PTR, data freshness — sortable, filterable, saved views, export
metrics.name: Institution performance table

metrics.formula: country and global aggregates computed from in-country state aggregates; each labelled verified, calculated or estimated
metrics.name: Global and national indicators (from state aggregates only)

metrics.formula: member-institution aggregates of ENR-COUNT, ATT-RATE, HEALTH-INDEX, EXAM-5CREDITS, FEE-COLLECTION
metrics.name: Network dashboard summary

metrics.formula: live attendance, open cover gaps (G8), critical maintenance, registers missing
metrics.name: LGA today — attendance

metrics.formula: approved positions filled by an active employment record ÷ approved positions
metrics.name: Establishment fill rate

metrics.formula: approved funded positions without an active employment record, by subject specialism
metrics.name: Vacant positions by subject

metrics.formula: separations in the last 12 months ÷ average active posts
metrics.name: Staff attrition

metrics.formula: active employment records with retirement_due_on within 12 months
metrics.name: Retirements due in 12 months

metrics.formula: Σ (entitled + carried over − taken) annual-leave days across staff
metrics.name: Leave liability

metrics.formula: open flags by kind; pay held by decision
metrics.name: Open payroll integrity flags

metrics.formula: clearance checks with result outstanding ÷ clearance checks
metrics.name: Incoming learners with outstanding obligations

metrics.formula: disputes upheld or partly upheld ÷ disputes resolved, by creditor institution (unsupported claims)
metrics.name: Obligation disputes upheld

metrics.formula: states that answered ÷ 37 (36 states and the FCT) per clearance check; states on the network ÷ 37
metrics.name: National clearance coverage

metrics.formula: trainees on intake ÷ intake capacity
metrics.name: Course intake fill rate

metrics.formula: trainees passed out or commissioned ÷ trainees with a final outcome
metrics.name: Trainee pass-out rate

metrics.formula: institutions with a supervising body, an accreditor where required and an examination body for examined levels ÷ institutions
metrics.name: Institutions with a complete regulatory profile

pages.purpose: Sessions, terms/semesters, holidays, examination windows and key dates. Inherited from state/country calendar with permitted institution variations.
pages.title: Academic calendar

pages.purpose: Configures education levels, year groups/grades, classes/arms, programmes and cohorts using the country education model (e.g. ECCDE, Primary 1–6, JSS1–3, SS1–3; ND/HND; 100–600 level).
pages.title: Year groups, classes & programmes

pages.purpose: Subject/course catalogue mapped to Subject 360 master and to curriculum. Higher education uses courses/modules with credit units.
pages.title: Subjects & courses

pages.purpose: Builds programmes (diplomas, degrees, TVET qualifications, professional programmes) from modules/courses with credits, prerequisites, core/elective status and progression rules.
pages.title: Programme builder

pages.purpose: Teacher's class page: roster, today's lessons, register, markbook shortcuts, authorised adjustments for learners, homework and messages.
pages.title: My class

pages.purpose: Build each class's subject offering with teacher of record, periods and curriculum version, validated live.
pages.title: Class subject plan

pages.purpose: One record per academic department: HOD, subject areas, programmes, accreditation, courses, lecturers and load.
pages.title: Department 360

pages.purpose: Allocate every course section of the semester to a lecturer of record with specialism and load checks.
pages.title: Course allocation

pages.purpose: Provider view of tenants (global, country, regional, institutional, department), plans, data residency and health.
pages.title: Tenants

pages.purpose: Country configuration layer: education levels, grade structures, calendars, qualifications, identifiers (e.g. NIN), age-of-majority and consent rules, attendance codes, grading scales, currencies, languages, mandatory datasets.
pages.title: Country configuration

pages.purpose: Self-service onboarding for an institution: organisation, academic structure, users and roles, billing, workflows, reports, branding and integrations — within mandatory government policies.
pages.title: Institution setup

pages.purpose: User accounts and role-at-scope grants; invitations, deactivation, access reviews.
pages.title: Users

pages.purpose: Role definitions and permission matrix (module × action), data-classification clearance and scope rules.
pages.title: Roles & permissions

pages.purpose: Ministry Policy Engine: version-controlled rules (attendance minimums, curriculum, teacher qualifications, exam eligibility, progression, certification, accreditation, registration) at global → country → state → authority → institution → department levels, with conflict detection.
pages.title: Policy & rule engine

pages.purpose: Configures workflows on the Universal Workflow Engine: steps, assignees, SLAs, approvals, escalations and forms.
pages.title: Workflow designer

pages.purpose: Connectors for LMS, finance, payroll, HR, assessment, library, catering, transport, payments, identity, communication, examination bodies, healthcare and government systems.
pages.title: Integration marketplace

pages.purpose: API clients and data-sharing agreements for the Global Education Data Exchange (records, transcripts, results, funding, attendance, outcomes).
pages.title: API clients & data exchange

pages.purpose: Data Governance Engine: classification, retention schedules, consent and legal basis, residency, subject-access and erasure requests, exports, minimisation reviews.
pages.title: Data governance

pages.purpose: Tamper-evident audit trail: who, what, when, where, why, previous value, new value, approval and related record.
pages.title: Audit log

pages.purpose: Platform-level translation: enabled languages, coverage, terminology overrides (e.g. 'pupil' vs 'learner', 'term' vs 'semester') and RTL support.
pages.title: Languages

pages.purpose: Tenant branding (logo, colours, crest, document templates) within accessibility constraints.
pages.title: Branding

pages.purpose: SaaS billing for the platform itself: per learner, institution, module, user, campus, enterprise, government contract, national deployment, trust or university-group licence — combinable.
pages.title: Subscription & licensing

pages.purpose: Imports legacy data (spreadsheets, CSV, previous MIS exports) through mapping, validation, matching against masters and staged commit with rollback.
pages.title: Data import & migration

pages.purpose: Availability, latency, error rates, queue depth, backup status and DR readiness per region.
pages.title: System health

pages.purpose: Merge queue and stewardship across all master entities (learners, guardians, staff, institutions, suppliers, courses, programmes, qualifications).
pages.title: Master data stewardship

pages.purpose: Event-to-notification rules, channels, templates, quiet hours, digests and escalation.
pages.title: Notification rules

pages.purpose: Browse and enable agent templates.
pages.title: Agent library

pages.purpose: Set triggers, scope, level, tools, limits and templates; simulate; approve.
pages.title: Configure agent

pages.purpose: Monitor every agent's status, results and live activity; pause instantly.
pages.title: Agent console

pages.purpose: Searchable record of every agent action with trigger, evidence, rule, outcome and undo.
pages.title: Agent activity log

pages.purpose: Every AI recommendation awaiting a human decision, each with finding, evidence, confidence, recommendation and the approve/reject decision.
pages.title: Recommendations queue

pages.purpose: Extracts structured data from uploaded forms, PDFs, certificates, transcripts, reports, contracts and invoices; flags missing data, duplicates, contradictions, expiry and key dates; a human validates consequential fields.
pages.title: Document intelligence

pages.purpose: Register of AI models and rules: purpose, owner, data used, excluded features, performance, fairness metrics, drift, human-oversight level and approval.
pages.title: Model governance

pages.purpose: Gradebook for a class/subject: assessments as columns mapped to curriculum objectives, marks, grades per configured scale, flags for missing work, and adjustments.
pages.title: Markbook

pages.purpose: Defines an assessment and traces it to curriculum objectives (Curriculum → Subject → Objective → Assessment → Performance).
pages.title: Assessment setup

pages.purpose: Configurable grading: percentage, letters, grade points, GPA/CGPA, pass/fail, competency levels, degree classifications.
pages.title: Grading scales

pages.purpose: Generates termly report cards / progress reports from markbooks, attendance, behaviour and teacher comments in the institution's branded template.
pages.title: Report cards

pages.purpose: Internal moderation and verification of marking: samples, moderator marks, adjustments.
pages.title: Moderation

pages.purpose: Fast lesson/session register for teachers on any device. Pre-fills known absences (parent-reported, trips, exams).
pages.title: Take register

pages.purpose: Institution or authority attendance: today, trends, persistent absence, patterns by day/period/cohort, and early warnings.
pages.title: Attendance dashboard

pages.purpose: First-day absence contact and escalation workflow: call/SMS guardians, record reasons, escalate repeated absence.
pages.title: Absence follow-up

pages.purpose: Account for every learner, member of staff and visitor at assembly points during an evacuation or drill, in real time, on mobile and offline.
pages.title: Evacuation roll call

pages.purpose: See registers not taken or left incomplete, nudge teachers with a direct link and track register compliance by teacher, institution and LGA.
pages.title: Register compliance

pages.purpose: Receive absences reported by parents through the app, WhatsApp or web, acknowledge them, apply the attendance code and query unauthorised reasons.
pages.title: Parent-reported absences

pages.purpose: Authenticate every user through one entry point. Supports federated SSO (government identity provider, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace), local credentials for small institutions and passwordless magic links for parents.
pages.title: Sign in

pages.purpose: Second factor for users whose role clearance is restricted or special, and for any user on a new device.
pages.title: Multi-factor verification

pages.purpose: Users holding several role-at-scope grants (e.g. a teacher who is also a parent, or a state officer seconded to an LGA) choose the context they will work in. The context sets navigation, default dashboard and data scope.
pages.title: Choose workspace

pages.purpose: Self-service password reset by e-mail link. Not available to SSO-only users.
pages.title: Reset password

pages.purpose: Quick capture of positive and negative behaviour events against the institution's behaviour policy.
pages.title: Log behaviour

pages.purpose: Patterns by learner, class, time, location and category; exclusions and suspension records.
pages.title: Behaviour overview

pages.purpose: Turn the institution's behaviour policy into configured positive and negative behaviours, points, default outcomes, rewards and achievement badges, within the minimum framework the state publishes.
pages.title: Behaviour policy and rewards

pages.purpose: Arrange a class on a room layout by drag and drop or by strategy, see each learner's context at a glance, log behaviour in two taps and use influence data to decide who sits where.
pages.title: Seating plan and influences

pages.purpose: Set thresholds on behaviour, attendance, homework and wellbeing data that trigger actions automatically, so low-level patterns are dealt with early and positive milestones are celebrated.
pages.title: Intelligence events

pages.purpose: Issue, share and track detentions by type, location, duration and supervisor; escalate missed detentions up the ladder automatically and report time owed.
pages.title: Detention manager

pages.purpose: Receive and respond to on-call requests raised from classrooms, with room, class and reason, acknowledgement times and escalation.
pages.title: On-call board

pages.purpose: Put a learner on report for a set period with personalised targets; every timetabled teacher rates and comments on each target, and parents can view and comment.
pages.title: On-report card

pages.purpose: Global Billing Rule Engine: define charge types and the rules that apply them by institution, campus, programme, course, year group, learner category, residency, citizenship, scholarship, family, funding source and level.
pages.title: Fee structure & billing rules

pages.purpose: Generates invoices for a period from rules; preview, exceptions, approval and issue.
pages.title: Billing run

pages.purpose: Individual learner ledger: charges, funding, discounts, payments, credits, balance and plan.
pages.title: Learner account

pages.purpose: One consolidated statement per family/payer across children and institutions, while each learner keeps an individual ledger.
pages.title: Family statement

pages.purpose: All invoices with status, ageing and payer.
pages.title: Invoices

pages.purpose: Instalment plans, hardship assessments, fee waivers and ethical recovery policy configuration.
pages.title: Payment plans & hardship

pages.purpose: Scholarships, bursaries, grants, sponsorships, employer funding, student loans and donor funding with caps and rules.
pages.title: Funding sources & sponsors

pages.purpose: Capitation, per-learner funding, institutional and conditional grants, development and donor funding reconciled so Government + Student payment + Scholarship + Sponsor = Total student funding, without double counting.
pages.title: Government funding reconciliation

pages.purpose: Authoritative register of awards and certificates issued by authorities and institutions in scope.
pages.title: Certificate register

pages.purpose: Batch Certificate Eligibility Engine for a cohort/series: each learner evaluated against the full chain from identity to award approval.
pages.title: Award eligibility run

pages.purpose: Intelligent cross-check before issuance. Only when every mandatory check passes (or an authorised exception exists) can a certificate be issued.
pages.title: Issue certificate

pages.purpose: Single certificate master record with everything that supports it, its verification history and lifecycle.
pages.title: Certificate 360

pages.purpose: Lifecycle actions: revocation, suspension, correction, replacement and reissue — each with authorised user, reason, date/time, evidence and approval. The original record is never deleted.
pages.title: Revoke, correct or reissue

pages.purpose: Certificate designs, security features, numbering rules and authorised signatories with signing keys.
pages.title: Certificate templates & signatories

pages.purpose: Log of all verifications (public, API, institutional) with failed lookups and suspected forgeries reported.
pages.title: Verification requests

pages.purpose: Work queue of certificate reissue and copy requests.
pages.title: Reissue requests

pages.purpose: Decide a reissue with the identity, archive and payment evidence in one place.
pages.title: Reissue review

pages.purpose: Cross-country view for international organisations and the global administrator. Shows aggregated, comparable indicators only, always labelled as verified, calculated or estimated.
pages.title: Global education dashboard

pages.purpose: Federal Ministry of Education control tower. Aggregated national view with drill-down Country → State → LGA → Institution → Department → Programme → Class → Learner (to the depth the user's clearance allows).
pages.title: National command centre

pages.purpose: State Ministry of Education operational and regulatory control tower: every registered institution in the state, public and private, with comparison against LGAs, prior year and government targets.
pages.title: State command centre

pages.purpose: Local education authority view: day-to-day operational monitoring of the institutions in one LGA or district.
pages.title: LGA / district command centre

pages.purpose: For Multi-Academy Trusts, school groups, university groups and faith/community networks: performance, finance and risk across member institutions.
pages.title: Network dashboard

pages.purpose: Head of institution home: today, this week, this month and this year for one school, college or university, with the institution health index decomposed.
pages.title: Institution dashboard

pages.purpose: Drill-down browser through the configured governance hierarchy. At every level the same indicator set is shown: performance, attendance, behaviour, safeguarding, SEND, staffing, finance, infrastructure, curriculum, assessment, compliance, risks and trends.
pages.title: Hierarchy explorer

pages.purpose: Investigation workspace that moves an administrator from Symptom → Evidence → Root cause → Action → Outcome. Opened from any alert, KPI or assistant answer.
pages.title: Follow the problem

pages.purpose: Global Education Alert Centre: every alert in the user's scope, categorised Critical / High / Moderate / Informational, with owner, due date and status.
pages.title: Alert centre

pages.purpose: Single alert with full explanation, evidence and actions.
pages.title: Alert detail

pages.purpose: One screen for the whole state: KPIs, where to act, LGA health and every institution's performance.
pages.title: State education control room

pages.purpose: Compare institutions fairly within comparable context groups and against their own trend.
pages.title: Institution league with context

pages.purpose: Track every institution's onboarding readiness and data freshness against LGA targets.
pages.title: Coverage and onboarding tracker

pages.purpose: The administrator's own record: scopes and delegations, portfolio of institutions, open alerts, investigations and improvement plans they own, decisions with outcomes, and briefing preferences — the fifth fundamental intelligence object.
pages.title: Education Administrator 360

pages.purpose: Cross-institution comparison: school vs school, LGA vs LGA, state vs state, programme vs programme. Contextual indicators are always shown alongside outcomes to avoid misleading league tables.
pages.title: Compare

pages.purpose: Positive intelligence: high-performing schools, outstanding teachers, successful interventions, improving attendance, strong financial management — and the practice behind them, so it can be shared.
pages.title: What's working

pages.purpose: Evidence-based identification of resource imbalances (learners, classrooms, teachers, funding). Recommends, never reallocates automatically.
pages.title: Resource allocation

pages.purpose: Global Education Planning Engine. Example: 'If enrolment increases by 15% over five years, how many additional teachers, classrooms and institutions will be required?'

pages.purpose: Data Quality Index by institution with the defects behind it: missing records, duplicates, invalid values, late submissions, inconsistencies, unverified records.
pages.title: Data quality command centre

pages.title: Send a message

pages.purpose: Sent messages, delivery/read status and reusable templates in multiple languages.
pages.title: Communication log & templates

pages.purpose: Handle two-way WhatsApp, SMS and app conversations with families, matched to their records.
pages.title: Conversations inbox

pages.purpose: Connect WhatsApp, Zenzap and other channels; manage templates, opt-ins, quiet hours and spend caps.
pages.title: Channels and templates

pages.purpose: Send scheduled messages to rule-defined audiences with cost estimate and results.
pages.title: Broadcast campaigns

pages.purpose: Send announcements to staff by relationship to a learner or role, and consent requests to parents with tracking, reminders and comments.
pages.title: Staff announcements and consent requests

pages.purpose: All curricula the user may see: national/federal, state adaptations, international frameworks (Cambridge, IB, Pearson), vocational/competency frameworks and institution-specific curricula, with versions and effective dates.
pages.title: Curriculum library

pages.purpose: Authoring environment for a curriculum version: structure (subject → strand → topic → learning objective/competency), mandatory/optional/recommended/restricted status, minimum teaching hours, instructional and resource requirements, assessment requirements and progression rules.
pages.title: Curriculum editor

pages.purpose: Approval and publication workflow: author → reviewer → approver → publish with effective date. Every change carries author, approver, version, date, effective date, reason and audit trail.
pages.title: Curriculum approval

pages.purpose: The curriculum as an intelligence object: authority, versions, applicable institutions, subjects, objectives, assessments, qualifications, teacher requirements and live compliance across adopters.

pages.purpose: State/local authorised additions or adaptations layered on a federal curriculum, with conflict detection against higher-level mandatory rules.

pages.purpose: Curriculum Compliance Engine result for an institution: compliance score with breakdown and specific deficiencies — not just a percentage.
pages.title: Curriculum compliance

pages.purpose: Geographic and hierarchical heatmap of curriculum compliance: National → State → District → Institution, filterable by subject, level, institution type, public/private, region and academic year.

pages.purpose: Conflicts between lower-level configuration and higher-level mandatory rules, and the exception requests that legitimately override them for a period.

pages.purpose: Teacher plans lessons against curriculum objectives and logs delivery; this is the primary evidence for curriculum compliance.

pages.purpose: Show, for any scope, whether every mandatory subject in every class has a qualified teacher of record, enough scheduled periods and evidence of delivery.

pages.title: Teaching assignment matrix

pages.purpose: List every open and closed coverage gap with severity, owner, due date, suggested fixes and history.
pages.title: Gap register

pages.purpose: Plan and monitor the state digitisation programme.
pages.title: Digitisation programme

pages.purpose: Track boxes and volumes from collection to disposition.
pages.title: Batches and custody

pages.purpose: Verify extracted fields against the page image and link records.
pages.title: Indexing and QA workstation

pages.purpose: Find any record by name variant, date, school, number or full text.
pages.title: Records search

RS-AI-LOG.note: Prompt and output logging with retention 30 days (Book 3 §28.3).
RS-AI-LOG.title: Assistant conversations and LLM prompt/output logs

RS-ATT.note: Aggregates are kept permanently in the warehouse.
RS-ATT.title: Attendance registers and marks

RS-AUDIT.note: Audit ≥ 7 years, configurable per jurisdiction; certificate and safeguarding audit retained with the record (Book 3 §15).
RS-AUDIT.title: Audit trail

RS-BEH.note: Exclusion and suspension decisions follow RS-LRN-PERM.
RS-BEH.title: Behaviour

RS-CERT-PERM.note: Certificates, events and signatures are never deleted (FR-CER-08).
RS-CERT-PERM.title: Certificate registry and lifecycle

RS-COMMS.note: Delivery metadata 7 years in the warehouse; letters stored to records follow their record series.
RS-COMMS.title: Messages

RS-CONFIG.note: Kept so past decisions remain explainable.
RS-CONFIG.title: Configuration

RS-CUR-PERM.note: Historical records keep the version they used (Gov §12).
RS-CUR-PERM.title: Curriculum versions

RS-DOC.note: Nothing is destroyed until the digital copy has passed QA and the records manager has approved (MFS §13.2).
RS-DOC.title: Documents and digitisation records (default — each document follows its record series)

RS-LMS.note: Marks posted to the markbook follow RS-LRN-PERM; coursework used as certification evidence is kept with results.
RS-LMS.title: Course spaces

RS-LRN-PERM.note: Admission registers and result records are kept permanently (MFS §13.6).
RS-LRN-PERM.title: Learner record (identity

RS-MDM.note: Merge journals of learners with certificates follow RS-LRN-PERM.
RS-MDM.title: Matching

RS-SAF.note: Follows the state records schedule (MFS §18.11); allegations about adults reviewed at retirement age or 10 years, whichever is longer.
RS-SAF.title: Safeguarding cases

RS-SDAF.note: Public-finance evidence for the Auditor-General; confirm under D10 and D26.
RS-SDAF.title: SDAF rates

RS-STF-FILE.note: Staff files kept 75 years from date of birth (MFS §13.6).
RS-STF-FILE.title: Staff personal file
